title: Kitulo Plateau: The Garden of God
excerpt: Kitulo Plateau in the Southern Highlands is known as the Garden of God: a high-altitude grassland full of wild flowers and orchids.
body:
Kitulo National Park lies on a high plateau in the Southern Highlands. It was the first park in tropical Africa created primarily to protect flora.

## Flowers

During the rainy season, roughly December to April, the grassland bursts into colour: orchids, red-hot pokers, aloes, lilies and many other flowers. Many species occur only in this region.

## Landscape

Rolling grasslands, at more than 2,600 m in places, with streams and forest patches. It feels more like the highlands of Scotland than like Africa.

## Wildlife

Few large mammals, but rare birds such as the Denham's bustard and several endemic plants and butterflies.

## Activities

Hiking and photography. Facilities are very basic.

## Getting there

Via Mbeya. This is a destination for people with time and a love of nature. Combine with [Mufindi](/blog/mufindi-highlands/) or [Ruaha](/blog/ruaha-national-park-guide/).

Read our [Kitulo page](/national-parks/kitulo-national-park/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
